clips.title: The story
paras: A Simple Rune is an inscribed stone token passed to fledgling dwarven warriors training in Coldridge Valley. It serves as a summons from the warrior trainer Thran Khorman, directing recruits to seek instruction inside Anvilmar.

Carved with basic martial marks, the Simple Rune is handed to promising recruits who have begun clearing out the threats around Coldridge Valley. Rather than a magical charm, it acts as a formal calling stone from Thran Khorman, the resident warrior trainer at Anvilmar. Upon reading its inscribed guidance, a young fighter is expected to report directly to Thran to learn basic combat techniques and hear practical advice on surviving Dun Morogh's hostile wilds.
